description: Search a user's OneDrive (Microsoft 365) for files and folders matching a query string across file names and content. Returns matching items with id, name, size, folder flag, last-modified time, and web URL. Use to find documents by keyword.

query.description: Free-text search query matched against OneDrive file names and content.

top.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 25).

name: onedrive_search_files
